purpose: Qualify conservative junction transport with freely evolving cell voltage before selecting a dynamic physical gate
initial_coordinate_rule: Seven coordinates from -1 to +1 in native cell-index order, centered by cell membrane area so total initial capacitor charge is zero; reverse negates these coordinates
physical_scope: Seven native cells, one physical pair or the seeded network, held-open junctions, impermeable membranes, fixed geometry and finite inert outside; no pumps, channels, dynamic gate, recovery or biological qualification
clock_policy: Compare elapsed completed updates k*dt; retain native storage labels without treating them as elapsed time
native_membrane_policy: Observe native cc_at_mem lag as-is; do not refresh it in the observer or replace native steps
preflight_basis: The four-step, 25-us network witness records 407.3 uV native trajectory error and 4.687e-5 pJ energy defect. Keep the 2-uV trajectory and 1e-7-pJ energy limits, transport and initial conditions; select a 100-us first panel and 97.65625/48.828125/24.4140625-ns native steps before launch. The production 25-us RK4 witness has 5.167e-10 fmol amount error, above its unchanged 2e-10-fmol limit; select 12.5/6.25-us Cells steps. No broader horizon is qualified by this pilot.
